title: Length bound for the straight-line program
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean DAG circuit on $n$ inputs in which every gate has at most two arguments, and choose an input index $i_0\in\mathrm{Fin}\,n$. The length of the straight-line program constructed from $C$ using $i_0$ is at most $2|C.\mathrm{gates}|+1$.
hypotheses_covered: C is a DAG circuit on n inputs
Every gate has at most two arguments
A chosen input index i₀ in Fin n
